schema.title: JSON Schema for defining the test periods

name.description: The name of this test period.

users.description: How many users does this period effect?

durationMinutes.description: How long should this period run for in minutes?

description: Please find the test period configuration for the upcoming load test below. The first phase, **Initial Ramp Up**, is a *RampUp* period that will bring **50 users** online over **10 minutes**. This is followed by the **Steady Load** phase, a *Constant* period maintaining **200 users** for **30 minutes**. Finally, the **Final Ramp Down** phase will gradually reduce the load with a *RampDown* period of **30 users** over **5 minutes**.
